description: Searches IP access control lists with the specified criteria and pagination.

name.description: The name of the IP access control list to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by. Supported values: id, insertInstant, lastUpdateInstant, name.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

name: searchIPAccessControlListsByParametersWithId
